scripts.workspace:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run test:all
scripts.release:mac:continue: npm run release:session:verify && node scripts/release.mjs continue
scripts.release:mac:resume: npm run release:preflight && npm run release:mac:continue
scripts.release:mac: npm run release:preflight && npm run release:prepare && npm run release:mac:continue
scripts.release:mac:ssh: npm run mac:ssh:keychain && npm run release:mac
scripts.release:mac:ssh:resume: npm run mac:ssh:keychain && npm run release:mac:resume
